rationale.conceptual: The method uses standard DFT for charged point defects with corrections (potential alignment, image charge). It is an established but non-trivial technique requiring careful implementation of formation energy formulas and multiple charge states/configurations. Not a trivial textbook operation, but not a novel algorithm.
rationale.execution: The pipeline involves host reference calculation, then ~27 defect supercell relaxations across many configurations, followed by formation energy post-processing. Requires external tooling (Quantum ESPRESSO) and orchestration of many independent jobs, making it a multi-stage pipeline with dependencies.
